category_title: Integrated student with ADHD who uses self-regulation and support staff to manage sensory/social overwhelm
scenario_title: High noise level during classroom lesson
minimal_context: Adam is participating in a classroom lesson with his peers at a table.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Adam, the classroom lesson is starting. Please sit at the table and work with the others.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: It's too loud. I feel this lesson is the hardest to manage right now.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Everyone is just talking about the assignment. Try to focus.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I can't cope with the situation by myself. I feel like I'm going to become angry and lose the ability to control my anger.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We need to get through this lesson. Please stay at the table.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Covers his ears and sits underneath a table) The noise level is too high!
